newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Re says M&G changes balance sheet.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Re says M&G changes balance sheet.

text.p: Swiss Reinsurance Co said on Friday its 1996 balance sheet was strongly affected by the acquisition of British group Mercantile & General Re, which was consolidated in the year-end balance but not the profit and loss account.
"The balance sheet has been substantially affected by the inclusion of assets and liabilities from Mercantile & General Re," Swiss Re said in a statement on 1996 results.
It said capital and reserves at balance sheet value increased by eight percent to 9.9 billion, Swiss Re said.
Technical provisions rose 46 percent from 1995 to 43.6 billion Swiss francs.
Investments at balance sheet value were 40 percent higher at 58.5 billion Swiss francs, Swiss Re said.
Swiss Re promised more detail on its 1996 results at a news conference and presentation to financial analysts on May 20.
A letter to shareholders and invitation to the annual general meeting would be sent out on May 5, Swiss Re said.
